text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.Today, let's go on doing assessment activities.Before class, please prepare your notebook, pencil and rubber.First, let's read two mails, ok?This mail is from Yang Yang.He says,You can read the text and understand the meaning of the message.This kind of topic is mainly about how you master the vocabulary.Wei suggests that you can read the text and understand the meaning of the message.According to the structure, determine the context.According to the situation, determine the context.Read the whole text and check the correction.These four steps are completed.Let's look at an example.This is a rat.Its name is Ratty.It is cute.It has small butt teeth.We read the text and guess the missing words to describe the shape of mouse teeth.Then, according to the context, fill in the words, sharp.Finally, read the text and check if the meaning is correct.Yang Yang, I believe you can master the correct method through practice.When we are describing people, animals or objects, we can use the thinking guide to help us organize the information.How can we describe your cute little cat?I think we can describe it in terms of name, body shape, appearance characteristics, food, abilities, etc.Jiu Jiu, why don't you give it a try?Now, let's begin.Go for your goal.Today, we are going to do five reading and writing activities.Try to get the stars.Gain the medals.If you get three medals, you can win the cup.Miss Wei, shall we begin?Okay, let's start from activity one.Read and write.Please take out your notebook and write down the numbers.Okay, please do it.Now, let's check the answers with Kitty.It is small.It is green.It has a hard shell.It's legs are short.It likes swimming in the water.It is a tortoise.Yes, it is a tortoise.Please check your spelling.Spell the word tortoise.T-O-R-T-O-I-S-E tortoise.It is white.It has a short tail.Its ears are long.It can't hop.It likes carrots.It is a rabbit.Yes, it is a rabbit.Spell the word rabbit.R-A-B-B-I-T rabbit.It is pretty.It lives in a cage.It has a sharp beak.Its feathers are beautiful.It can speak.It is a parrot.Good, it is a parrot.Spell the word parrot.P-A-R-R-O-T parrot.Kitty can choose the right words and spell the words correctly.So, she can get three stars.What about you, children?How many stars do you have?Please draw the stars on your notebook.Then, let's move to activity 2.Read, choose, and complete.First, write down the numbers.Please write us many names.Please write us?睡觉看,这是Kitty的答案非常好Kitty可以选择对的词词和用对的形式你呢,孩子们?让我们来看Kitty的答案Peter有个猫她是个猫她的名字是Ginger她喜欢吃鱼和猫的食物她每天都吃很多猫的食物她肥胖看,她在袋子里睡着Kitty现在有6个星星孩子们,你呢?我觉得你也做得很好,对吗?请把你的记录写在记录书上让我们来看活动3读,选择,写读,选择,完成请写下数字读,选择,写你完成了吗?现在让我们来看答案1.什么猫的旅程呢?什么东西牠吃呢?来看Kitty的答案她的答案是对的让我们读一下语言我是A,你是B杰尼有什么胖子呢?杰尼有9个星星来吧现在让我们来看活动4读,选择,写请把你的记录写在记录书上读,选择,写请把你的记录写在记录书上读,选择,写请把你的记录写在记录书上现在让我们来看答案1.我们选择C因为牠是白的胖胖喜欢吃肉和蛋糕牠喜欢喝牛奶和果汁3.Tim's grandmother不喜欢胖胖因为4.我们选择B她经常把她的书放在桌子上现在让我们来看杰尼的答案非常好杰尼的答案正确杰尼又得到了3个星星你们的答案怎么样?Let's wait!Let's move on!OK, let's go!The last activity, let's think and write.JoJo's pet cat.I'll show you a video of the pet cat.You can get more information from the video.How can you get stars in this activity?Let's have a look.Now, please think and write.This mind map can help you.Look, this is Kitty's writing.JoJo has a pet.She is a cat.Her name is Bingbing.She is a little fat.She is white and grey.She has big eyes.Bingbing likes fish.She eats cat food too.She can run and jump.She is so lovely.How many stars can Kitty get?Kitty can write more than five sentences.So, she can get the first star.She can spell the words correctly.因此,她可以得到第二个星星她对不同的方面写了什么吗?让我们看看因此,Kitty可以对不同的方面写了什么吗?她可以得到第三个星星在最后的活动中,你能得到多少个星星呢?你可以问你的教练Kitty,你真的做得很好!太不可思议了!我得到了所有星星!我太开心了!我得到了第三个星星!因此,Kitty,你得到了冠军!游戏结束了!孩子们,你们喜欢游戏吗?你们知道听,说,读和写的方法吗?这就是所有!再见,孩子们!
